newsitem.title: CANADA: Guards hostage in Quebec prison escape attempt.
newsitem.headline: Guards hostage in Quebec prison escape attempt.

text.p: Prisoners at a provincial detention center in Valleyfield near Montreal were holding three guards early Friday, Quebec Provincial Police spokesman Gerard Carrier said, and police were seeking a peaceful end to the hostage situation.
"We are presently negotiating with one of the inmates to have a peaceful conclusion," he said.

Carrier said the guards were taken prisoner about 11 p.m. Thursday (0300 GMT) after three or four prisoners attempted to escape. One inmate reached the roof but gave himself up after police arrived on the scene.
The other inmates locked up three guards inside a cell on the third floor of the detention center.
He said a total 60 prisoners were inside the facility, where inmates with sentences of two years or less are housed. He said he had no information whether injuries or weapons were involved.
Valleyfield is about 18 miles (30 kms) south of Montreal.
